actions.observation: The ROI around the cursor changed during the X override and matched the baseline exactly after clear. This is a reversible one-axis visual response, not a hover or selection comparison.

actions.input: Mouse Y field 106 -> 90 (the MAME Apollo driver negates Y, giving a positive sample delta); no buttons.

The combined X/Y and signed negative-X captures did not provide a measurable cursor destination. They are inconclusive and are not treated as successful motion.
